items.prompt: Why should first_at_least reuse the same sorted ladder across queries [8,1,4]?

options.text: The prior query's final lo and hi always work for the next query.
options.why: Unordered queries require a fresh full search interval each time.

options.text: The array is already sorted and immutable; each query starts fresh bounds.
options.why: No per-query sorting or array copying is needed.

options.text: Sorting after each answer restores a mutated array.
options.why: The search does not mutate the ladder.

options.text: The ladder must be sorted by query order instead of price.
options.why: Binary search relies on price order, not query arrival order.

items.explanation: No per-query sorting or array copying is needed.
